jetbrains.cachecontrol.it-deletes-corrup: It deletes corrupt blobs, the entries that name them, unused blobs and leftover files. The next run of an affected task is slower.
jetbrains.cachecontrol.what-was-broken-i: What was broken is removed from the cache
jetbrains.cachecontrol.it-removes-the-le: It removes the least recently used entries, then the blobs no entry uses.
jetbrains.cachecontrol.it-deletes-the-lo: It deletes the local cache. The remote cache stays, and the next run of every task is slower.
